Descriptions.ShortDescription: Experimental PSF Guard Director with bounded local target scheduling.
Descriptions.LongDescription: Experimental Director with shared-core local target scheduling, ranked priorities and Moon avoidance inside bounded allocations. Supports pairing, automatic workload requests, live or deferred check-ins, native NINA centering, rotation, autofocus, guiding, dithering and meridian flips, plus custom sequence hooks. Requires explicit acquisition, safety and enclosure policies. Settled-night restart is opt-in; uncertain-work resume and real-sky full-night acceptance remain unavailable. Do not use for unattended imaging. Director is separate from PSF Guard Sync and does not replace or change Sync.
